text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1812345678 — Serving degradation detected. Reports of increased tail latency and 5xx error spikes affecting inference endpoints in eu-west-2 and sa-east1. Trigger: error_rate > 3% for 10m on api-prod. Pager sent to #incidents and current on-call.

maya_patel: acked — I'm on it, pulling logs now.

alex_garcia: oncall? saw alerts too. can someone confirm which routes are impacted (generate vs embeddings)?

maya_patel: initial triage — primarily text-generation (v1 models) and streaming responses. embeddings appear stable for now.

prashant: copying the quick check list:
```
- check host health (nvidia-smi, disk, i/o)
- check routing table for eu-west-2 and sa-east1
- check recent deploys (last 6h)
- check autoscaler events and pool exhaustion
```

maya_patel: hosts seem healthy, GPU utilization normal. I see increased queue depth on the eu-west-2 RPC gateway and several 502s from model-proxy. Possible upstream connection churn to redis KV cache (used for prefix caching).

sarah_ops: I'm going to flip routing to bypass eu-west-2 cache cluster to test. Will update status page if we see improvement.

incident-bot: action — create status-page draft in #incidents (template).

alex_garcia: Suggested mitigation: temporarily route eu-west-2 traffic to eu-west-1 warm pool and enable degraded-mode quantized model (lower mem) for high tail requests. This keeps latency bounded while we debug cache.

maya_patel: running canary reroute now:
`/bin/routingctl shift --from eu-west-2 --to eu-west-1 --percent 20 --route-generation`

incident-bot: deploy-bot: routing shift 20% started by maya_patel.

maya_patel: 20% shift complete — observing 10% drop in 5xx and 8% tail latency improvement. increasing to 60%...

prashant: quick note for status page: we should be explicit about affected regions and guidance: eu-west-2 and sa-east1 primarily for text generation. Add mitigation steps and ETA.

maya_patel: 60% shift completed. 5xx reduced to ~1.2%, tail latencies trending down. continuing to 100% if stable.

cs_lead: heads up — customers X and Y are routing critical inference through eu-west-2. prepping a short notification.

eng-lead: also flagging that Dedicated customers with pinned eu-west-2 capacity must be informed about potential degraded perf and recommended fallback to eu-west-1 or dedicated failover pools.

maya_patel: 100% shift done for generation routes. sa-east1 is showing similar cache errors; starting a separate 100% reroute to sa-east1 fallback (sa-east1 -> sa-east1-bypass).

incident-bot: status-draft: (please copy/paste to status page)

```
We are currently investigating increased error rates and higher tail latencies for text-generation API endpoints in the following regions: eu-west-2 (London) and sa-east1 (Sao Paulo).

Impact: some generation requests may fail with 5xx or experience increased latency. Embeddings endpoints are not impacted.

Mitigation: traffic has been rerouted to fallback pools (eu-west-1 and sa-east1-bypass) to restore service while we investigate cache instability. No data loss is expected. We will provide updates every 30 minutes.

Current status: partial mitigation in effect (traffic rerouted). Engineers are investigating root cause (cache cluster connection churn).

Next update: in 30 minutes or when there is a material change.
```

maya_patel: posting to status page now.

cs_lead: customer notification (short template):
```
Subject: Service disruption affecting inference in EU & SA regions — temporary mitigation in place

Hi <CustomerName>,

We detected an issue affecting text-generation responses in our EU (eu-west-2) and South America (sa-east1) regions. We have rerouted traffic to fallback capacity which should restore normal responses; some requests may still see higher latency while we complete investigation. No customer data has been impacted.

What you can expect: reduced errors and latency as traffic finishes shifting to fallback pools. If you operate a geo-specific traffic policy, consider temporarily directing traffic to eu-west-1 or using our global endpoint to avoid regional impact.

We will send another update in 30 minutes or sooner if anything changes. Sorry for the disruption and thank you for your patience.

— Redwood Inference Status Team
```

prashant: good. add a note for Dedicated customers about contacting their account rep for pre-approved failover if they have pinned capacity.

maya_patel: root cause hypothesis: increased connection churn between model-proxy and cache frontends after an autoscaler event around 03:12 UTC. Looking into recent autoscaler logs and redis latency metrics.

alex_garcia: logs snippet showing redis timeout spikes: 
```
[03:12:14] model-proxy eu-west-2 - ERROR - redis timeout 500ms (ops=prefix_read)
[03:12:15] model-proxy eu-west-2 - WARN - reconnecting to cache frontend (err=ECONNRESET)
[03:12:16] autoscaler - scale up pods (count=3 -> 8)
```

maya_patel: engineering action items:
- keep reroute in place until cache cluster stabilizes or we fail back gradually
- rotate primary cache frontend nodes (maintenance window) if churn persists
- postmortem owner assigned after incident

sarah_ops: I'm creating an on-call handoff note for the night shift: please include mitigation state, actions in progress, and SLO impact.

maya_patel: handoff note (for night-oncall):
```
- Incident ID: 1812345678
- Affected: text-generation in eu-west-2 and sa-east1
- Current mitigation: traffic fully rerouted to fallback pools (eu-west-1, sa-east1-bypass).
- What to monitor: 5xx rate, queue depth on routing gateway, redis p99 latency, model-proxy error counts.
- Next steps: if errors persist after 60m: rotate cache frontends and consider temporary cache bypass for prefix reads.
- Pager: if 5xx > 2% for 15m escalate to eng-lead and exec oncall.
- Contact: maya_patel (primary), alex_garcia (secondary)
```

night-oncall: ACK — will pick up at 03:45 UTC, will monitor and keep status page updated.

incident-bot: reminder — schedule postmortem and set severity = S2 if customer-impacting.

prashant: noted. I'll start the incident timeline and collect metrics snapshots.

cs_lead: I'll queue the customer notifications for affected accounts; hold for 10 minutes to confirm metric stability then send.

maya_patel: currently stable for 12 minutes since full reroute. 5xx at 0.9%, tail latencies ~15% over baseline. continuing monitoring.

alex_garcia: one more note — consider adding a short-term autoscaler cooldown to prevent cascading scale events while we finish root cause.

maya_patel: good call. applying cooldown: `kubectl annotate ns/prod autoscaler.cooldown=5m`

incident-bot: action recorded — cooldown annotation added by maya_patel.

sarah_ops: thank you all. will update postmortem owner once incident declared resolved.

maya_patel: leaving a quick snippet for runbook updates: add a checklist to reroute generation traffic and customer communication templates for region failovers.

night-oncall: taking over monitoring. signing off from this thread. :wave:
